So either engineer is to the right of chess lover, or same position? The statement "not anywhere to the left of" means that the engineer is not in a position with index less than the chess lover's position. So engineer's position >= chess lover's position. So engineer is either at same position (i.e., same person) or to the right.

Thus engineer is not left of chess lover. So engineer's position is >= chess lover's position.
